headline: Open platforms enable in-place exploration of large biological datasets and knowledgebases
label: Open Biological Data Platforms
summary: Single-cell atlases approaching 100M cells make in-place, browser-based analysis a practical alternative to local download of full datasets.
synthesis: The shared thread is infrastructure that lets researchers query large biological resources in place rather than relying on local copies. SingloCell provides an open, browser-based environment for exploring multimodal single-cell datasets spanning transcriptomics, proteomics and ATAC profiles. CyteArc extends in-place analysis to remote atlases at roughly 100-million-cell scale, with provenance tracking and minimal disk use, and CyteBase supports cross-cohort screening. At the knowledge layer, canSAR 2026 updates a public drug discovery knowledgebase integrating multi-source data with machine-learning predictors and druggability tools, and Europe PMC 2026 expands an open literature database of 48M abstracts with text-mined and new machine-learning annotations. The new element across these items is the focus on access and reuse infrastructure.
